title: Two system facts to lock
question: North star is Functional Clarity. Tokens are extracted. Two facts in the code conflict with older docs — DESIGN.md needs your call. Use the note if the color name “Click Violet” for #7C3AED is wrong.

options.label: Manrope + event serif, flat chrome
options.thesis: UI is Manrope. Source Serif 4 is the display face for event titles only. Chrome is flat: 1px seams, tonal stacking, no drop shadows on cards.
options.body: Shadows may exist on menus, popovers, and map overlays — those are floating layers, not product chrome. Primary buttons keep the 2px press nudge. CardVisual gradients stay the only sanctioned non-flat paint, and only on entity identity.
options.case: Matches globals.css, EventListCard, EventCreateForm, and the 01-design-system-web bans.

options.label: Manrope only, serif is drift
options.thesis: The system is Manrope only. Source Serif 4 on events is a local exception to record as drift, not a display token.
options.body: Same flat chrome, same 2px press, same CardVisual exception. DESIGN.md will not list a display serif.
options.case: Matches AI.md and 01-design-system-web.md “Manrope only — no Space Grotesk.”

options.label: Keep the serif; shadows are in-system
options.thesis: Manrope + Source Serif 4 for event titles, and existing shadows (menus, chat, QR, radar) are part of elevation — not drift.
options.body: Document a small shadow vocabulary for overlays while cards stay bordered and opaque. Still no glass, glow, or gradient chrome.
options.case: Matches scattered shadow-lg / shadow-xl usage in chat, events, insights.
